'''Kettch''' was a dark-furred Ewok present on [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] around [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]]. After the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], he was involved in the brief conflict between the Ewoks and their fellow [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion]] allies, the [[Lahsbee/Huhk|Lahsbees]], which developed at the instigation of the [[Hiromi]] known as [[Hirog]].<ref name="Hasbro" /> Kettch donned Imperial [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] chest armor and carried a hatchet to prepare for the war that never came.<ref name="MC 94" />

Kettch shared his name with a [[Kettch|fictional]] Ewok [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]] pilot serving with [[Wraith Squadron]], invented as a prank by pilot [[Wes Janson/Legends|Wes Janson]].<ref name="X-Wing: Wraith Squadron">''[[X-Wing: Wraith Squadron]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The name "Kettch" first appeared as part of a prank by Wraith Squadron pilot Wes Janson, who made up a fictional Ewok candidate for membership in the squadron as a joke to [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]].<ref name="X-Wing: Wraith Squadron" /> The prank was continued by the rest of the squadron, eventually including a stuffed Kettch toy.<ref name="X-Wing: Iron Fist">''[[X-Wing: Iron Fist]]''</ref> There was no suggestion that a real Kettch existed until a [[Hasbro]] action figure set featured a figure bearing the name, revealing him to be an Ewok in [[Marvel Comics]]' [[Star Wars (1977) 94|''Star Wars'' 94]]. The figure used the same sculpt (including the cowl) as the earlier Ewok figure [[Romba]], along with a [[Stormtrooper]] breastplate originally released with [[Han Solo]].

The package's image of the Kettch action figure<ref name="Hasbro" /> matches an Ewok in the Marvel comic wearing an orange hood and stormtrooper armor, wielding a hatchet.<ref name="MC 94" />
